title: [4.x] Big Problems on Android
body:
### Tested versions

4.3, 4.4 dev 1..7 (All)
...
Android 11 (SDK 30)
Android 12 (SDK 31)
Android 13 (SDK 33)
Android 14 (SDK 34)

### System information

Working in Linux / Ubuntu 22.04

### Issue description

There are a lot of incomprehensible problems that cannot be identified.
